documented_change: OnToma was rewritten and phenotype mapping was enhanced for ClinGen, Gene2Phenotype, Orphanet, Genomics England PanelApp, IMPC, Gene Burden and Pharmacogenetics.
analytical_relevance: Disease identifiers and association support may move when source phenotypes are normalised differently.
causality_boundary: Context only; association-level records are required before attributing a ranking change.

documented_change: Ensembl 115 data were incorporated.
analytical_relevance: Target roster and annotation changes are plausible and must be audited by stable Ensembl gene identifier.
causality_boundary: The release note does not establish that any observed association change was caused by the Ensembl update.

documented_change: The tagged implementation uses a 100,000-term harmonic normaliser; the later implementation changes the numerical normaliser and component cap.
analytical_relevance: The release-native overall score remains the common conceptual endpoint but numerical invariance across 25.12 to 26.03 cannot be assumed.
causality_boundary: The known implementation discontinuity is reported separately from evidence-count change and is not described as biological evidence revision.

documented_change: PROGENy, SLAPenrich and Gene Signatures (SysBio) were removed from the associations view; release data also include updates from Probes&Drugs, Reactome and EVA through ClinVar.
analytical_relevance: Datasource support may leave or enter release-native rosters.
causality_boundary: Only the downloaded association rows can establish whether a particular pair changed.

documented_change: GWAS Catalog credible sets increased by 78%; COLOC-PIP was added, multi-ancestry GWAS SuSiE credible sets were removed and Enhancer-to-Gene predictions were exposed.
analytical_relevance: Genetic association and gwas_credible_sets remain prespecified sensitivity objects but their support can change materially.
causality_boundary: Release coincidence does not assign a genetic-pipeline cause to an individual ranking change.

documented_change: No new clinical-mining pipeline was documented for this release.
analytical_relevance: No release-specific clinical-mining mechanism is assigned.
causality_boundary: Absence from release highlights is not evidence that underlying clinical records were unchanged.

documented_change: No release-specific literature-pipeline change was documented in the release highlights.
analytical_relevance: Literature-sensitive changes require association-level datasource support rather than temporal inference.
causality_boundary: No causal interpretation is assigned.

documented_change: ChEMBL 36 introduced updated molecules, indications and drug warnings.
analytical_relevance: Known-drug support may change but the later clinical_precedence object is not assumed to be a rename of chembl.
causality_boundary: Drug-data timing alone cannot explain a disease-target score revision.

documented_change: Download files were split by datasource.
analytical_relevance: The required association_by_datasource_direct dataset is source-specific and its physical fields are closed in the release schema.
causality_boundary: Schema organisation is not itself a biological change.

documented_change: Platform pipeline orchestration underwent large-scale refactoring.
analytical_relevance: This is retained as operational context and excluded from direct scientific attribution.
causality_boundary: Infrastructure context is not used as a cause of ranking change.

documented_change: Measurement traits were filtered by default in the target association view but could be restored by the user.
analytical_relevance: This is a user-interface default and does not demonstrate removal from the bulk direct-association datasets.
causality_boundary: The bulk files determine analytical support.

documented_change: Approximately 300 overlapping disease-phenotype terms were merged or removed to resolve ontology duplications.
analytical_relevance: Apparent entrants and exits may be mapping-affected and require explicit identifier evidence.
causality_boundary: Ontology context cannot by itself prove that a pair changed only because of mapping.

documented_change: The release reports 78,691 targets but no specific stable-target identifier migration.
analytical_relevance: Exact Ensembl gene identifiers remain mandatory and annotation changes are audited separately.
causality_boundary: Release-level target counts do not establish identifier continuity for an individual target.

documented_change: Novelty and time-series calculations were integrated into a unified association schema; minor API and web-interface default-setting inconsistencies were aligned. Tagged code uses a 1,000-term harmonic normaliser and top-50 component cap.
analytical_relevance: The release-provided overall score remains primary; the 25.12 transition has a documented implementation discontinuity and later contextual fields are excluded from the common estimand.
causality_boundary: Raw release-native score change includes implementation change and must not be called pure evidence revision.

documented_change: Clinical Precedence became a new evidence feed, with new ClinVar and ClinPGx data through EVA and updates from STRING and IntAct.
analytical_relevance: The datasource inventory treats clinical_precedence as a new definition rather than a rename of chembl.
causality_boundary: Association rows are required to trace any particular top-set change.

documented_change: The GWAS Catalog update added 710 studies and more than 5,000 credible sets; rE2G features were added to Locus-to-Gene and an LD-liftover correction affected fewer than 1% of credible sets.
analytical_relevance: Genetic sensitivity remains comparable by release-provided datatype and datasource scores while support changes are expected.
causality_boundary: No case-level causal attribution follows from the release note.

documented_change: A new clinical-mining pipeline integrated AACT, ChEMBL curated indications and warnings, TTD, EMA and PMDA and supplied Clinical Precedence evidence.
analytical_relevance: The change creates a source-definition break relative to the 25.12 chembl datasource label.
causality_boundary: Clinical-pipeline timing is contextual until association-level support is traced.

documented_change: No specific literature-mining implementation change was documented in the release highlights.
analytical_relevance: Literature effects are not assigned for this transition without datasource-level evidence.
causality_boundary: No causal interpretation is assigned.

documented_change: The clinical pipeline integrated ChEMBL indications and warnings with AACT, TTD, EMA and PMDA; the release reports 22,230 drugs and compounds.
analytical_relevance: Drug and clinical evidence definitions changed and must be kept distinct from the earlier chembl datasource label.
causality_boundary: Release totals do not attribute an association-score change.

documented_change: Association outputs moved to a unified schema with aggregationType, aggregationValue, associationScore, embedded timeseries and novelty fields.
analytical_relevance: Downstream code must assert the selector and explicitly map associationScore to the internal score field; added novelty fields do not enter the primary estimand.
causality_boundary: Schema reconciliation is explicit and is not interpreted as biological evidence change.

documented_change: AWS Open Data access was introduced, non-search datasets moved from OpenSearch to ClickHouse and end-to-end testing was implemented.
analytical_relevance: These changes concern access and service infrastructure rather than the frozen bulk-data estimand.
causality_boundary: Infrastructure context is not used as a cause of ranking change.

documented_change: API and web-interface default settings were aligned after minor scoring inconsistencies.
analytical_relevance: The statement concerns serving defaults and does not by itself establish a change in the downloaded default-weight overall score.
causality_boundary: The release-specific bulk bytes and tagged implementation control the analytical score.

documented_change: EFO 3.88 replaced many disease identifiers with Mondo identifiers and the Platform adopted those ontology changes.
analytical_relevance: A large explicit replacement stratum is expected and must remain separate from stable-identifier comparisons.
causality_boundary: Only explicit record-level replacement evidence supports mapping.

documented_change: The target count remained 78,691; isoform-specific subcellular-location metadata were added, but no stable-target identifier migration was documented.
analytical_relevance: Stable Ensembl identifiers remain the mapping key and target annotation fields remain sensitivity attributes.
causality_boundary: Target-count equality is not proof that all target annotations are unchanged.

documented_change: No new core association-score equation or normaliser change was identified relative to the tagged 26.03 implementation.
analytical_relevance: The same later-release associationScore selector contract is retained; observed changes remain release sensitivity.
causality_boundary: Implementation continuity does not assign evidence-source causality.

documented_change: The release added an NHSE Genomic Medicine Service PanelApp panel, newer IMPC and GWAS Catalog data, and large clinical and literature pipeline updates.
analytical_relevance: Release-native support can expand or contract; datasource labels alone do not reveal row-level causes.
causality_boundary: Pair-level support must be traced before attribution.

documented_change: More than 14,000 GWAS Catalog studies from 111 publications added 27,689 credible sets and more than 105,000 variants; two trans-pQTL features were added to Locus-to-Gene.
analytical_relevance: Genetic support changes are expected while genetic_association and gwas_credible_sets retain stable labels.
causality_boundary: No individual ranking change is assigned to a genetic feature without source-level evidence.

documented_change: AACT drug-disease extraction was refined, adding 4,742 clinical reports, 32,518 drug-indication pairs and 292,325 clinical-precedence evidence records.
analytical_relevance: Clinical Precedence retains its label but its content changes materially across the transition.
causality_boundary: Temporal alignment is contextual rather than causal proof.

documented_change: Ontology grounding, entity disambiguation and co-occurrence generation were updated, including stricter filtering of ambiguous mappings.
analytical_relevance: Literature support may drive release-native roster change and must be tested from release-provided datasource scores.
causality_boundary: The documented change cannot be assigned as the cause of a particular target-rank change without association-level support.

documented_change: ChEMBL 37 was incorporated and molecular structure images were updated.
analytical_relevance: Drug-evidence content can change while image changes are outside the analytical endpoint.
causality_boundary: The ChEMBL update does not establish causality for an association change.

documented_change: The association datasets retain the 26.03 unified aggregation schema; target subcellular-location metadata include release-specific additions.
analytical_relevance: The later-release selector contract is stable while contextual target fields remain release-specific.
causality_boundary: Schema continuity and metadata additions are not biological causal claims.

documented_change: Release-management revisions, a public Helm Chart initiative, migration to Otter 26 and a workflow step for AWS loading were documented.
analytical_relevance: These are retained as infrastructure context and excluded from scientific attribution.
causality_boundary: Infrastructure context is not used as a cause of ranking change.

documented_change: The release notes report approximately 600,000 direct associations removed by literature updates, whereas the official release page reports 60,000 losing literature support; baseline-expression and interface changes also lie outside the frozen association endpoint.
analytical_relevance: The ten-fold discrepancy is preserved as unresolved contextual metadata and neither number is used as a quantitative analytical result.
causality_boundary: The downloaded association data rather than either contextual total controls the study.
